exposure: 1 mg of phenylephrine (made in 2 mL of 0.9% saline) IM
2 mg of phenylephrine (made in 2 mL of 0.9% saline) IM
3 mg of phenylephrine (made in 2 mL of 0.9% saline) IM
cohort: 104 pregnant mothers undergoing elective caesarean section.
finding: Prophylactic administration of 3mg intramuscular phenylephrine was effective at reducing the incidence of spinal anaesthesia induced hypotension in elective caesarean section.
